files.processing: Hokkaido rows only; Sapporo wards dropped in favour of the city total. Totals checked against the Hokkaido row (2025: 4,985,419; 2020: 5,224,614). Area is from the GSI area survey as given in the table.

notes: The six villages of the Northern Territories (codes 01695–01700) are in the boundary file with in_census = false; the census does not cover them.
The simplified polygons are for drawing only. Use area_km2 in the CSV, not polygon areas.
